plugins.name: ringcentral-ace
plugins.description: ACE provides complete visibility into customer calls, meetings, and digital interactions. Managers can compare agent performance and turn quality metrics into targeted, evidence-based coaching backed by real interaction data. Executives gain clear foresight into key trends, competitor activity, churn risks, and customer satisfaction across all conversations.
